slides.label: INSIDE · THE MOVEMENT
slides.headline: A wheel turns one notch
slides.body: Each press turns a column wheel one step.

slides.label: STEP 1 · START AND STOP
slides.headline: One press starts, one stops
slides.body: The start pusher sets the sweep hand moving. Press it again to stop.

slides.label: STEP 2 · RESET
slides.headline: A second pusher resets
slides.body: The reset pusher returns the hands to zero.
